name: Egan Hub Storage Header Expansion (Line 73 loop)

values.EndLocation: Texas Gas Transmission meter and regulating station

researcher_notes: Passes the add-threshold. The loop is new 24-inch pipe, not a partial share. A Natural Gas Intelligence article from October 2007 says FERC certificated a new 16.5-mile, 24-inch loop of the Line 73 header, plus a new meter station for Texas Gas Transmission, under docket CP07-88. A later Natural Gas Intelligence article says the remaining 8.5 miles were cleared for service, making the header 16.5 miles. So the 8.5 miles is only the last tranche, and the full 16.5 miles is new pipe, above the 15.5 mile floor. The EIA August 2026 release (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 652, project name Egan Storage Header Exp, operator Spectra Energy, completed September 2010) states 16.52 miles, 24 inches, 200 MMcf/d added capacity, cost 25 million dollars. EIA length is the figure staged, in miles. Cost staged in full dollars. Status operating from the EIA completed date; the dated FERC order itself was not opened, so the exact in-service date of each tranche is unconfirmed. Not matched to any existing roster row; no Egan, Spectra or Acadia Parish row covers it. Owner entity is Egan Hub Storage LLC, then a Spectra Energy subsidiary; entity lookup found no close existing entity, and no legal-form registry check was done. Parent (likely Enbridge Inc, which absorbed Spectra) is not stated in these sources, so it is left blank. EIA and the news article are separate publishers, but the news article reports the FERC order, so a direct FERC order or docket CP07-88 filing would be a good third check. Route: none found; route research not done. Suggest RouteType unavailable, no official GIS located. Egan Hub is in Acadia and Evangeline parishes, Louisiana. Interstate pipeline under FERC.
